messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Aaj Biomolecules ko ratne ke bajay ek map se samjhenge. Living cell ke major chemical groups — carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, enzymes aur vitamins — ko structure, function aur exam-trap ke saath connect karenge.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya biomolecule ka matlab har wo molecule hai jo body mein milta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Broadly biological system mein milne wale molecules ko biomolecules kehte hain. Kuch small molecules hote hain, jaise glucose, aur kuch macromolecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids. Pehle classification clear karenge, phir examples.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai Sir, pehle map bana leta hoon; phir har group ka difference poochunga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Biomolecules ko do useful angles se dekho. **Micromolecules** chhote hote hain — water, salts, vitamins, glucose. **Macromolecules** bade molecules hote hain — proteins, polysaccharides aur nucleic acids. Lipids bade zaroor ho sakte hain, par usually true repeating-unit polymers nahi hote.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, to lipid ko protein jaisa polymer nahi bolna chahiye?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Protein amino acids ki chain aur nucleic acid nucleotides ki chain hota hai. Lipid ka common triglyceride glycerol aur fatty acids se banta hai, lekin uski structure regular repeating monomer chain jaisi nahi hoti.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye “large molecule” aur “true polymer” ka difference note kar raha hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Primary metabolites growth aur normal metabolism ke liye directly important hote hain — amino acids, sugars, nucleotides, proteins. Secondary metabolites survival ya interaction mein help karte hain — alkaloids, pigments, essential oils, gums, rubber aur antibiotics jaise examples milte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Kya secondary ka matlab useless hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi. “Secondary” ka matlab basic growth ke liye universal requirement nahi, useless bilkul nahi. Plant ka nicotine defence mein help kar sakta hai, pigment pollinator ko attract kar sakta hai, aur antibiotic microbes ke against useful ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Samajh aa raha hai — primary core metabolism, secondary special role; ab quiz se check karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Which pair contains one true biological polymer and one molecule that is not usually treated as a true repeating-unit polymer?
quiz_payload.explanation: Protein amino-acid residues ki chain hai, jabki triglyceride glycerol aur fatty acids se bana lipid hai aur regular repeating-unit polymer nahi maana jata. Cellulose, glycogen, DNA, RNA, starch aur chitin polymers hain.

quiz_payload.question: Assertion (A): Amino acids and glucose are commonly treated as primary metabolites. Reason (R): They participate directly in growth, energy or biosynthetic pathways.

options.text: A aur R dono sahi hain aur R, A ki sahi explanation hai
A aur R dono sahi hain, par R sahi explanation nahi hai
A sahi hai, R galat hai
A galat hai, R sahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Primary metabolites normal growth, energy production aur biosynthesis se directly jude hote hain. Amino acids aur glucose is category ke common examples hain.

quiz_payload.question: Which statement about lipids is the safest exam-level statement?

options.text: Every lipid is a true polymer of one repeating monomer
Triglycerides contain glycerol and fatty acids and lipids are generally hydrophobic
All lipids dissolve easily in water
Lipids are made only of amino acids

quiz_payload.explanation: Triglyceride glycerol plus three fatty acids se banta hai. Lipids generally water mein insoluble ya poorly soluble aur non-polar/hydrophobic nature ke hote hain; unhe automatically true polymers nahi bolna chahiye.

milestone_payload.title: Biomolecule Map Clear
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Good start! Ab structure ko carbohydrate, protein aur enzyme examples se build karenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Carbohydrates ko simple language mein sugars aur unke larger forms samjho. Monosaccharide ek single sugar unit hota hai. Glucose aldohexose hai — six carbon aur aldehyde group; fructose ketohexose hai — six carbon aur ketone group.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Glucose aur fructose dono C6H12O6 hain, phir alag kaise?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Same molecular formula but different arrangement/function ko isomerism se jod sakte ho. Glucose aur fructose dono hexose hain, lekin functional group alag hai. Isliye formula dekhkar structure identical mat maan lena.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Formula same ho sakta hai, structure alag — ye carbon chapter se bhi connect hua.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Do monosaccharides condensation se judkar disaccharide bana sakte hain; water molecule nikalta hai aur **glycosidic bond** banta hai. Sucrose = glucose + fructose, lactose = glucose + galactose, maltose = glucose + glucose.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir sucrose ko table sugar bolte hain, aur lactose milk sugar?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan. Sucrose non-reducing sugar hai, jabki maltose aur lactose reducing sugars hain. Reducing property ko free anomeric carbon/reducing group se connect karke padho; sirf “sweet” hone se reducing decide nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sucrose, lactose, maltose ke components aur reducing nature ko alag table mein likhunga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Polysaccharides long sugar chains hote hain. Starch plants ka storage carbohydrate, glycogen animals aur fungi ka storage form, cellulose plant cell wall ka structural polymer, aur chitin fungal cell wall aur arthropod exoskeleton mein milta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hum starch digest kar lete hain, par cellulose kyun nahi?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Human digestive system mein cellulose ke beta-1,4 glycosidic bonds todne wala cellulase enzyme nahi hota. Ruminants ke gut microbes cellulose digestion mein help karte hain. Structure aur enzyme compatibility ko link karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Starch storage hai, cellulose support; bond orientation digestion ka trap ban sakta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Which pair is correctly matched?
quiz_payload.explanation: Lactose milk sugar hai aur glucose + galactose se bana disaccharide hai. Sucrose glucose + fructose aur maltose glucose + glucose se banta hai. Cellulose plant structural polysaccharide hai.

quiz_payload.question: Which carbohydrate is conventionally non-reducing because both anomeric carbons participate in the glycosidic bond?
quiz_payload.explanation: Sucrose mein glucose aur fructose ke anomeric carbons bond mein involved hote hain, isliye free reducing group nahi bachta aur sucrose non-reducing sugar maana jata hai.

quiz_payload.question: A plant cell wall, an animal storage granule and an arthropod exoskeleton are best matched respectively with:
quiz_payload.explanation: Plant cell wall cellulose se, animal storage glycogen se, aur arthropod exoskeleton chitin se associated hai. Starch plant storage carbohydrate hai.

milestone_payload.title: Carbohydrates Connected
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Monosaccharides, disaccharides, polysaccharides and reducing sugars
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Good! Ab proteins ke level, bond aur denaturation ko step-by-step dekhenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Proteins amino acids ki polypeptide chains hain. Har amino acid mein generally amino group, carboxyl group, hydrogen aur variable R-group alpha carbon se jude hote hain. R-group amino acid ka character decide karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, amino acid ka naam “amino” aur “acid” dono groups ki wajah se hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Do amino acids condensation reaction mein judte hain; carboxyl group aur amino group ke beech water nikalta hai aur **peptide bond** banta hai. Chain chhoti ho to peptide, lambi folded chain ko protein ke context mein padhte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Peptide bond ko amide linkage bhi bolte hain na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Protein structure ke 4 levels yaad karo: primary = amino-acid sequence; secondary = alpha-helix/beta-sheet; tertiary = single chain ka 3D folding; quaternary = multiple polypeptide subunits ka arrangement, jaise haemoglobin.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sequence badal jaaye to sirf shape nahi, function bhi badal sakta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan. Sequence folding aur active site ko affect kar sakta hai. Bonds ko mix mat karo: peptide bond primary chain banata hai; hydrogen bonds secondary structure ko stabilize karte hain; disulfide bridges tertiary/quaternary stability mein help kar sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Primary se quaternary tak “sequence se multiple subunits” ka ladder bana raha hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Heat, extreme pH, organic solvents ya heavy-metal ions protein ki higher-order structure disturb kar sakte hain; ise **denaturation** kehte hain. Usually secondary, tertiary aur quaternary structure affect hoti hai, primary peptide sequence generally intact rehti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Isliye egg white heat par solid ho jata hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, egg proteins unfold aur aggregate hote hain. Denaturation ko hydrolysis mat samjho — hydrolysis peptide bonds tod sakta hai, denaturation mainly folding/shape badalta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Shape badalna aur chain todna alag processes hain; ye distinction important hai.

quiz_payload.question: A peptide bond is formed between the:

options.text: Carboxyl group of one amino acid and amino group of another

quiz_payload.explanation: Condensation mein ek amino acid ka carboxyl group aur doosre ka amino group water eliminate karke peptide/amide bond banate hain.

quiz_payload.question: Which example best represents quaternary protein structure?
quiz_payload.explanation: Quaternary structure multiple polypeptide chains/subunits ke association ko describe karti hai; haemoglobin iska common example hai.

quiz_payload.question: Which statement about denaturation is most accurate?

options.text: It always breaks every peptide bond
It usually disrupts higher-order folding while the primary sequence may remain intact
It converts every protein into a carbohydrate
It increases the number of amino acids in the chain

quiz_payload.explanation: Denaturation mein protein ka native folding disturb hota hai. Primary amino-acid sequence generally intact reh sakti hai; complete hydrolysis alag process hai.

milestone_payload.title: Protein Structure Understood
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Amino acids, peptide bond, four structural levels and denaturation
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Nice! Ab catalysts ko enzyme ke active site, cofactors aur inhibition se connect karenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Enzymes mostly globular proteins hote hain jo biological catalysts ki tarah reaction ki activation energy kam karte hain. Reaction fast hoti hai, lekin enzyme equilibrium constant ya final equilibrium position ko normally change nahi karta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Catalyst product ko force nahi karta, bas reaction tak pahunchne ka barrier kam karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Enzyme substrate ke saath temporary enzyme-substrate complex banata hai aur alternate lower-energy pathway deta hai. Enzyme reaction ke end mein permanently consume nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh enzyme ki quantity kam ho sakti hai, par substrate concentration aur conditions bhi matter karengi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Protein part ko **apoenzyme** aur required non-protein helper ko **cofactor** kehte hain. Apoenzyme + cofactor = active **holoenzyme**. Cofactor inorganic ion ho sakta hai, organic coenzyme ho sakta hai, ya tightly bound prosthetic group.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Vitamin ka coenzyme se relation hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Kai vitamins ya unke derivatives coenzymes ke components ban sakte hain. NAD⁺, FAD aur coenzyme A jaise helpers electron/group transfer mein assist karte hain; har vitamin directly enzyme nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Apoenzyme inactive protein part, holoenzyme active complete form — ab terms alag hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Enzyme activity temperature, pH, substrate concentration aur inhibitors se affect hoti hai. Temperature optimum tak rate badha sakta hai; bahut high temperature protein denature kar sakta hai. Har enzyme ka pH optimum same nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Competitive inhibitor substrate ki seat par baithta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan. Competitive inhibitor active site ke liye compete karta hai; substrate badhane se effect kuch extent tak overcome ho sakta hai. Non-competitive inhibitor alag site par bind karke shape/activity badal sakta hai; sirf substrate badhana usually enough nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Graph yaad rakhne ke saath “condition-specific” answer dunga, one-rule-for-all nahi.

quiz_payload.question: Apoenzyme plus its required cofactor is called:
quiz_payload.explanation: Apoenzyme protein part aur cofactor helper milkar active holoenzyme banate hain.

quiz_payload.question: Why can a very high temperature reduce enzyme activity?

options.text: It permanently adds amino acids to the enzyme
It can disrupt the enzyme’s three-dimensional structure
It converts all substrates into vitamins
It removes all water from the cell instantly

quiz_payload.explanation: Excess heat non-covalent interactions disturb karke enzyme ko denature kar sakti hai; active-site shape badalne par activity girti hai.

quiz_payload.question: A competitive inhibitor is most directly expected to:

options.text: Bind the active site and compete with substrate
Destroy the enzyme’s peptide sequence immediately

quiz_payload.explanation: Competitive inhibitor substrate ke active-site binding se compete karta hai. Substrate concentration badhane par competition ka effect kuch extent tak reduce ho sakta hai.

milestone_payload.title: Enzyme Mechanism Clear
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Activation energy, cofactors, factors and inhibition
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Excellent. Ab lipids ko storage, membrane aur hormone-related roles ke saath compare karenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Lipids mostly hydrophobic biomolecules hain. Triglyceride ek glycerol molecule aur teen fatty acids se banta hai; ester bonds form hote hain. Lipids energy storage mein useful hote hain, par membrane lipids ka role structural bhi hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Fat aur oil dono triglyceride ho sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, fats room temperature par generally solid aur oils liquid hote hain; ye chain length aur unsaturation par depend karta hai, absolute rule nahi. Saturated fatty acid mein C=C nahi hota, unsaturated mein ek ya zyada double bond hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: C=C ki wajah se packing aur melting point change ho sakta hai — isliye oil liquid rehta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Phospholipid mein hydrophilic phosphate head aur hydrophobic fatty-acid tails hote hain; isi amphipathic nature se cell membrane bilayer banti hai. Steroids ka four-ring framework hota hai; cholesterol membrane ka component aur steroid hormones ka precursor hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Phospholipid ka head paani ki taraf aur tail paani se door?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Is orientation se aqueous environment mein bilayer stable hoti hai. Cholesterol ko sirf “bad” mat samjho — amount aur context important hai; body mein membrane aur hormone synthesis mein role hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Membrane ke liye amphipathic design ka reason clear ho raha hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cis double bonds fatty-acid chain mein bend la sakte hain, packing kam karte hain aur melting point reduce kar sakte hain. Hydrogenation unsaturation kam kar sakti hai; partial hydrogenation se trans fats banne ka concern hota hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh “unsaturated healthy” bhi blanket rule nahi, type aur amount matter karta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Nutrition advice ko simple chemistry slogan na banao. Exam ke liye saturated/unsaturated structure, cis-trans distinction aur hydrogenation ko alag rakho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Structure se property aur health context tak link bana raha hoon.

quiz_payload.question: A phospholipid is amphipathic because it has:

options.text: A polar/hydrophilic head and non-polar/hydrophobic tails

quiz_payload.explanation: Phospholipid ka phosphate-containing head hydrophilic aur fatty-acid tails hydrophobic hote hain; isi se membrane bilayer possible hoti hai.

quiz_payload.question: Which change generally lowers the melting point of a fatty-acid mixture?
quiz_payload.explanation: Cis double bonds chain mein bends create karke packing reduce karte hain; many unsaturated oils therefore lower melting point dikhate hain.

quiz_payload.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: Cholesterol can be a membrane component and steroid-hormone precursor
Every lipid dissolves readily in water
Triglyceride is made from three amino acids

quiz_payload.explanation: Cholesterol membrane structure aur steroid-hormone synthesis mein role play karta hai. Triglyceride glycerol aur fatty acids se banta hai.

milestone_payload.title: Lipids Compared
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Triglycerides, fatty acids, phospholipids and steroids
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Good comparison. Ab DNA, RNA, nucleotides aur ATP ko ek sequence mein jodenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nucleic acids genetic information aur protein synthesis se related biological polymers hain. Unke repeating units **nucleotides** hote hain. Nucleotide = pentose sugar + phosphate group + nitrogenous base; nucleoside mein phosphate nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir nucleotide aur nucleoside ka difference ek phosphate ka hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, exam mein ye direct trap hai. DNA ke nucleotide mein deoxyribose, phosphate aur A/T/G/C base hota hai; RNA mein ribose, phosphate aur A/U/G/C base hota hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sugar ka 2-prime OH DNA-RNA difference ka core point hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: DNA usually double-stranded antiparallel helix hota hai. A aur T ke beech 2 hydrogen bonds, G aur C ke beech 3 hydrogen bonds. RNA usually single-stranded hota hai aur thymine ki jagah uracil use karta hai; RNA folded structures bhi bana sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: RNA hamesha single-stranded hota hai kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Usually single-stranded bolna safer hai; kuch viruses mein double-stranded RNA bhi mil sakta hai. mRNA message carry karta hai, tRNA amino acid laata hai, rRNA ribosome ka structural/catalytic part hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: DNA ko always double aur RNA ko always single bolna trap ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nucleotides phosphodiester bonds se chain banate hain. ATP mein adenine + ribose + teen phosphate groups hote hain; ATP ko cell ka immediate energy-transfer molecule kaha jata hai. Energy “bond tootne se magically” nahi, hydrolysis aur products ke stability difference se release hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: ATP ko energy currency bolte hain, lekin usko unlimited battery nahi samajhna hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. ATP continuously synthesize aur use hota hai. Nucleic acid backbone mein sugar-phosphate chain hoti hai; bases information pairing aur sequence provide karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Currency analogy helpful hai, par ATP ka cycle bhi yaad rakhunga.

quiz_payload.question: A nucleotide contains:

options.text: Pentose sugar, phosphate and nitrogenous base
Only a nitrogenous base and amino acid

quiz_payload.explanation: Nucleotide ke teen components pentose sugar, phosphate group aur nitrogenous base hain. Base + sugar only nucleoside hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: DNA normally uses uracil instead of thymine
RNA always has two strands and never folds
DNA has deoxyribose while RNA has ribose
Both DNA and RNA use exactly the same four bases

quiz_payload.explanation: DNA mein deoxyribose aur usually A,T,G,C; RNA mein ribose aur usually A,U,G,C hota hai. RNA folding aur exceptions ko context ke saath padho.

quiz_payload.question: In a typical DNA double helix, which base-pairing statement is correct?

options.text: A pairs with T through two hydrogen bonds
A pairs with C through three hydrogen bonds
G pairs with T through one hydrogen bond
U is the standard DNA partner of A

quiz_payload.explanation: DNA mein A–T pair ke beech 2 aur G–C pair ke beech 3 hydrogen bonds hote hain. RNA mein A–U pairing common hai.

milestone_payload.title: Nucleic Acids Connected
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Nucleotides, DNA/RNA, base pairing and ATP
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Good! Ab vitamins ko solubility, sources aur deficiency traps ke saath revise karenge.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Vitamins organic micronutrients hain; body ko small amounts mein chahiye. Ye energy ke main fuel nahi, par enzymes/coenzymes, vision, immunity, clotting aur metabolism mein important roles ho sakte hain. Vitamins ko excess supplement samajhkar self-medicate nahi karna.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Vitamins energy nahi dete, par energy-release pathways ko support kar sakte hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul. Fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, K body mein store ho sakte hain; water-soluble B-complex aur C generally regular intake maangte hain, though B12 ka reserve comparatively long-term ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Solubility se storage aur toxicity ka risk bhi connect karna hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Vitamin A vision aur epithelial health se linked hai; deficiency se night blindness ho sakti hai. Vitamin D calcium-phosphate balance aur bone mineralisation mein help karta hai; deficiency children mein rickets aur adults mein osteomalacia se linked hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Vitamin D ko sunlight se relation hai, par kya sunlight khud vitamin D hoti hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nahi. UVB skin mein precursor se vitamin D synthesis initiate karti hai, phir liver/kidney activation steps hote hain. Vitamin E antioxidant role se aur Vitamin K clotting-factor activation se associated hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: A-D-E-K ko fat-soluble mnemonic se yaad karunga, deficiency ko overgeneralize nahi karunga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Vitamin B-complex ke alag members ke alag roles/deficiencies hote hain: B1 deficiency beri-beri, B3 deficiency pellagra, B12 deficiency megaloblastic/pernicious anaemia context, folate deficiency megaloblastic anaemia aur pregnancy mein neural-tube risk. Vitamin C deficiency scurvy se linked hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: B-complex ko ek single vitamin samajhna galat hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan, B-complex group hai, ek molecule nahi. Water-soluble hone ka matlab “kabhi toxicity nahi” bhi nahi; high-dose supplements harmful ho sakte hain. Source aur clinical diagnosis ke bina deficiency label mat lagao.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Disease-name aur vitamin ko matching table mein practice karunga.

quiz_payload.question: Which set contains only fat-soluble vitamins?
quiz_payload.explanation: A, D, E aur K fat-soluble vitamins hain. B-complex aur C ko generally water-soluble group mein rakha jata hai.

quiz_payload.question: A child with poor bone mineralisation and bowed legs is classically associated with deficiency of:
quiz_payload.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency calcium/phosphate handling aur bone mineralisation ko affect karke children mein rickets se associated ho sakti hai. Clinical diagnosis doctor karta hai; exam association ko disease diagnosis na samjho.

quiz_payload.question: Which pairing is correct?

options.text: Vitamin K — normal blood-clotting factor activation

quiz_payload.explanation: Vitamin K clotting-factor activation, Vitamin A vision, B1 beri-beri, C scurvy aur D rickets se associated exam pairings hain.

milestone_payload.title: Vitamins Revised
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Ab last revision mein groups compare karenge; Raju, answer se pehle reason bhi bolna.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: One-page map: carbohydrates = energy/storage/structure; proteins = amino-acid polymers and functions; enzymes = biological catalysts; lipids = hydrophobic storage/membrane/hormone-related molecules; nucleic acids = nucleotide polymers for information; vitamins = organic micronutrients with solubility-based exam traps.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Main pehle category, phir building block, phir function aur exception check karunga — sirf example dekhkar answer nahi mark karunga.

quiz_payload.question: Consider the statements: 1. Cellulose is a plant structural polysaccharide. 2. Glycogen is a major animal storage polysaccharide. 3. Sucrose is conventionally a reducing sugar. Which is correct?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Sucrose is conventionally non-reducing because both anomeric carbons are involved in its glycosidic bond.

quiz_payload.question: Assertion (A): Enzymes can accelerate a reaction without changing its equilibrium constant. Reason (R): They provide an alternate pathway with lower activation energy.

options.text: A aur R dono sahi hain aur R, A ki sahi explanation hai
A aur R dono sahi hain, par R explanation nahi hai
A sahi hai, R galat hai
A galat hai, R sahi hai

quiz_payload.explanation: Enzymes lower activation energy through an alternate pathway, so equilibrium is reached faster but the equilibrium constant/position is not changed by the catalyst.

quiz_payload.question: Match the following: (P) Vitamin D, (Q) DNA, (R) Phospholipid — with (1) base-paired information polymer, (2) amphipathic membrane molecule, (3) bone mineralisation role.
quiz_payload.explanation: Vitamin D is linked with calcium/phosphate and bone mineralisation, DNA is a base-paired information polymer, and phospholipid is an amphipathic membrane molecule.

milestone_payload.title: Biomolecules Complete
milestone_payload.completed_topic: Carbohydrates, proteins, enzymes, lipids, nucleic acids and vitamins
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Chapter complete! Ab revision mein weak pairings ko spaced practice se dobara check karna.
